Book an artist who is already coming

Every artist below has a real show on the calendar near you and an available night next to it. Pick your city and dates, then ask. If another room has already asked, you will see it, and the two of you can share the trip.

How it works

  1. 1
    Pick your city and dates

    Choose where your room is and when you want a show. We look at Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights.

  2. 2
    See who is already coming

    Each artist has a real show booked near you and an available night next to it. Press play to hear them.

  3. 3
    Ask for a night

    Tell us what you can cover and we take it to the artist. If another room has asked too, you will see it and can split the travel.

Already nearby with an available night

Based nearby

We book Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights. "Available" means no show is listed for the artist that night. It is taken from public listings and is not a confirmation from the artist, and no price is implied. "Nearby" means the same city or within 150 miles of the listed show. Artists and venues can ask to be left off or claim their page.

Artists billed at venues in the region, from public show listings. Nobody here has signed up yet. Rates show once an artist tells us one.

One flight. Three shows.

An artist is already flying in for one show, and the nights around it are open. The artist plays more paid shows on one trip. Nearby rooms get a touring act for close to what a local costs. The promoter who booked the flight gets some of it back.

Artists, agents, or the promoter who booked the first night.
